text:
ada: Heads up  new partner goes live with unpredictable batch windows. Need a tiny customer-facing 'surge ops kit' they can paste into their runbook. Must cover: cache TTLs, client dedupe, batching backpressure, streaming fallback, quick telemetry checks, and a renewal early-warning pulse. Keep it super short and copy/pasteable.

miguel: I'll draft. Try to include one curl header example, one SDK hint, and a single SQL that they can run.

sophie: Call out a simple dedupe pattern: include a client-generated request_id to avoid double-sends on retries. That saves tokens during retries.

miguel: Draft (customer-facing, paste-ready):

SURGE OPS KIT (copy into ops runbook)
1) Auth & model pin: verify API_KEY and model pin; run 3 sanity calls (short, context, malformed).
2) Cache (proxy/CDN): short shared TTL for repeat prompts reduces duplicate token spend. Example curl header: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
     -H "Cache-Control: public, max-age=22, stale-while-revalidate=60" \
     -H "X-Request-ID: ${REQUEST_ID}" \
     -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: partner_acct_77" \
     https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
3) Client dedupe: include request_id and idempotency_key; drop duplicate processing at edge if seen within 60s.
4) Batching + backpressure: start conservative. SDK hint (JS): 
```js
client.generate({batchPolicy: {maxBatchTokens: 600, maxWaitMs: 40, backpressureFraction: 0.8}})
```
5) Streaming vs polling: prefer streaming for interactive routes. If chunk integrity errors >1% over 5m, fallback to polling with 1s interval and open a ticket.
6) Circuit-breaker & token-safety guard: recommended guard = p95 < 400ms AND 5xx < 1% AND duplicate_token_rate < 2%. If breached for 10m, enter conservative mode: halve batch tokens, disable speculative retries, extend cache TTL to 60s.
7) Quick telemetry (single SQL): shows p95, 5xx%, dup token rate over last hour: 
```sql
SELECT
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95,
  100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN status >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) AS pct_5xx,
  100.0 * sum(case when duplicate_request_id is true then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) AS pct_dup
FROM requests
WHERE tenant = 'partner_acct_77' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```
8) Renewal early-warning pulse (dashboard language):
  0 Healthy: stable QPS, p95 within target, token costs steady
  1 Monitor: small p95 drift OR dup token rate creeping up
  2 Outreach: sustained p95 breach OR >1% 5xx OR duplicate token rate >3% (CS reaches out)
  3 Warroom: QPS collapse OR >3% 5xx OR token spend >3x baseline (open CS+SRE)
9) Short-term capacity: for >10x baseline bursts email capacity@redwood with baseline QPS, expected peak, and window.

sophie: Add a tiny prefill tip: prime top-5 prompts during quiet minutes into a KV cache (TTL 30s) to cut duplicated generation on demos.

miguel: Add rollback play: set header `X-Redwood-Mode: safe` to force conservative execution paths (pins quantization and disables speculative batching) while we triage.

infra-bot: Note: link this kit to /confluence/cs/surge-kits (auto-link).

ada: Can you compress to a one-page PDF and drop in #cs-assets? Keep it under 220 words if possible.
